name: DJMax Respect: V Liberty Pack
summary:
DJMax Respect V: V Liberty Pack is a rhythm game DLC that adds new original songs to the base game. The V Liberty Pack features music from diverse composers and is playable on the same difficulty and modes as the base game.

Track list:
- Final Hour (Game Ver.)
- Song For You
- Follow Me
- Cold Generation
- Cotton Candy Soda
- Growing Pains
- Confession in Another World ~Pan Remix~
- Bestie
- Synchronize
- Petunia
- Rhythm In My Head
- TRAP
- Break Out
- Final Round
- Broken Sphere
- Basement
- Licrom
- Diomedes
- O'men
- Away
